title: Twenty-unit build plan — bounded passes, mirror comparison and evidence trail
advancement_rule: A unit advances only after both BUILD PASS and TEST PASS evidence are recorded. Timeout, failure, unexplained red state, moving origin, inaccessible evidence or scope expansion blocks advancement.

evidence_strategy.per_unit: append one compact record to the ledger and one machine-readable receipt

mirror_contract.failed_unit_policy: abandon branch and record blocking evidence rather than repair speculatively outside the unit budget

reserved_decisions: Product Owner designation of the current Trueself before B026-06
licence choice and confirmation of Ventus Ltd release rights
authorisation of any programme after B026-20

units.title: Mirror integrity and drift detection
units.build_scope: Authenticate the working mirror against origin and record head SHA, commit date, message, tracked file count, branch count and repository size. No production file change.
units.test_scope: Run capsule-link and programme-state synchronisation checks and name any divergence from the previous ledger state.
units.acceptance: Mirror identity is explicit, capsule links pass, programme state is in sync, and drift is named rather than inherited.

units.title: Clean environment provisioning
units.build_scope: Create a fresh virtual environment and install the package using only documented commands. No production file change.
units.test_scope: Import solar_topology from the installed package and verify its reported version against pyproject.toml.
units.acceptance: Installation succeeds without hidden prerequisites, or the exact hidden prerequisite is recorded as a blocking defect.

units.title: Full local validation envelope reproduction
units.build_scope: Run the complete local Python suite and capture exact counts. No production file change.
units.test_scope: Run pytest duration reporting and record the ten slowest tests.
units.acceptance: Local green or red state is stated exactly and is never misreported as CI state.

units.title: Clean-wheel authority reproduction
units.build_scope: Build the wheel and install it into a second isolated environment. No production file change.
units.test_scope: Run both clean-wheel gates against the installed package rather than the checkout.
units.acceptance: Both clean-wheel boundaries reproduce their declared result and any working-tree dependency is recorded.

units.title: Change, test, patch and revert rehearsal
units.build_scope: On a throwaway branch make one no-op edit, commit it and produce a patch.
units.test_scope: Run one focused test and the full local envelope, reset the tree and verify byte identity with the recorded head.
units.acceptance: The complete loop finishes inside budget and leaves no state behind except evidence.

units.title: Reconcile programme-state and current Trueself
units.build_scope: Update only the current Trueself pointer, named Build 026 tranche and single next goal after Product Owner designation. Preserve all unrelated programme-state fields.
units.test_scope: Run TS-005 handoff tests and programme-state drift checks.
units.acceptance: Prose and machine authority agree, exactly one active tranche exists and no unrelated field changes.

units.title: Deliberate root gitignore
units.build_scope: Classify tracked and generated artefacts, then add a root .gitignore based on current Python and Node patterns plus local build candidates.
units.test_scope: Verify no tracked engineering artefact becomes ignored and a full test run leaves the working tree clean.
units.acceptance: No tracked file is removed; untracking proposals are deferred to a separate programme.

units.title: One clean installation and one start command
units.build_scope: Document exactly one supported installation sequence and one command that starts the authority service and reports the Studio URL.
units.test_scope: Run a scripted clean-clone install and startup smoke check.
units.acceptance: A fresh clone reaches a ready health route and working Studio without remembered preparation.

units.title: Quantity-kind typing
units.build_scope: Add explicit quantity kinds to qualified equipment values, including Isc, Imp, operating-current limit, short-circuit limit, Voc and Vmp. Add no comparison behaviour.
units.test_scope: Verify every relevant field carries a kind and all serialisation or hash changes are listed.
units.acceptance: No calculation result changes and quantity meaning is explicit.

units.title: Comparison compatibility guard
units.build_scope: Add a helper that rejects incompatible quantity kinds rather than returning a misleading comparison.
units.test_scope: Isc against an operating-current limit must reject; Imp against a compatible operating-current limit may compare when conditions align.
units.acceptance: The unlike-rating error identified in the continuity series is structurally impossible.

units.title: Versioned datasheet evidence fixture
units.build_scope: Create a machine-readable fixture for the exact public module and inverter datasheets with source identity, revision and hashes. Missing sources remain unresolved.
units.test_scope: Validate the fixture schema and prove every downstream promoted value resolves to one fixture source.
units.acceptance: No engineering arithmetic reads manufacturer values from prose.

units.title: Rear-gain current screening
units.build_scope: Load front, 5 percent and 10 percent Imp and Isc values from the fixture and add separate compatible screening channels.
units.test_scope: Reproduce 34.70, 36.44 and 38.18 A for Imp and 36.90, 38.74 and 40.60 A for Isc without emitting unsupported compliance, clipping or thermal conclusions.
units.acceptance: Each result carries margin, quantity kind, evidence class and source identity rather than an invented verdict.

units.title: Evidence-class monotonicity
units.build_scope: Make every derived value inherit the weakest evidence class among its inputs.
units.test_scope: Use property-based and targeted tests to prove no derivation becomes stronger than its weakest input, including assumed permittivity producing assumed capacitance.
units.acceptance: Any existing canonical result whose evidence state changes is explicitly listed.

units.title: Cold open-circuit voltage with explicit method
units.build_scope: Add cold Voc calculation with explicit minimum-temperature input and a separately named tolerance policy that is off by default.
units.test_scope: Reproduce 1377 V at STC and approximately 1497.5 V at minus 10 C; prove tolerance is absent unless selected.
units.acceptance: The method question remains explicit data and no automatic compliance verdict is issued.

units.title: String-group module-profile binding
units.build_scope: Permit module profiles to bind at string-group level rather than only whole-project level.
units.test_scope: A two-group block with different bins aggregates correctly and records each bin; the legacy single-profile block remains byte-identical where the schema permits.
units.acceptance: A profile change affects only its own receipt branch.

units.title: Per-pole factory-lead lengths
units.build_scope: Preserve positive and negative factory-lead lengths separately and let routing consume them.
units.test_scope: Verify 2.1 m asymmetry across one 30-module string and 50.4 m across 24 strings, with explicit receipt and hash consequences.
units.acceptance: The correction to prior installed-length reporting is stated and no other routing method changes.

units.title: Declared slack and coil geometry
units.build_scope: Add declared installed slack and geometry state with explicit provenance, defaulting to unresolved rather than zero.
units.test_scope: Declared slack contributes to length and receipts; undeclared slack remains an unresolved evidence item.
units.acceptance: Field-created geometry becomes visible without inventing a coil where none is evidenced.

units.title: Named assumption register
units.build_scope: Create a register for standing assumptions such as relative permittivity, temperature cases and tolerance policy, each with owner and state.
units.test_scope: Validate the register and require every assumption-dependent derivation to cite its entry.
units.acceptance: No assumption is used anonymously.

units.title: Governance contradiction gate
units.build_scope: Detect conflicting named quantities across governance documents unless explicit source-to-target supersession exists.
units.test_scope: A seeded contradiction fails and a properly superseded pair passes.
units.acceptance: Repeated model prose cannot promote conflicting values into apparent truth.

units.title: Snapshot expiry and verdict vocabulary gates
units.build_scope: Add one bounded governance-validation unit covering commit-bounded observational claims and controlled use of violation, exceeds, complies and fails.
units.test_scope: Seeded stale or unbound claims fail; current commit-bounded and method-bound claims pass; both checks run inside the existing validation envelope.
units.acceptance: Observations cannot masquerade as live state and verdict language cannot outrun source, method or compatible quantities.
